intentAssessment.english: Results included a recent Canvas-specific change explainer and broader hardware-upgrade fingerprint articles. Those are adjacent to, but narrower than, a cross-signal browser/OS update regression workflow.
intentAssessment.chinese: Results included general fingerprint checker pages, a hardware-upgrade drift tutorial, and Canvas/WebGL-focused material. Search results do not establish whether users prefer one intent or quantify demand.
intentAssessment.existingSiteCoverage: The catalogue has distinct Canvas and WebGL tests, a signal glossary, a broad first-pass fingerprint checklist, and a User-Agent Client Hints check. No current slug owns dated before/after regression attribution across browser and OS versions, fonts/GPU drivers, and privacy-policy changes.
intentAssessment.decision: Proceed with one new bilingual guide. Preserve the existing signal-specific and full-checklist intent owners; focus this page on controlled baseline comparison, change classification, repeatability, and regression acceptance.
intentAssessment.deduplicationBoundary: Do not retell the mechanics of Canvas/WebGL hashing or repeat the entire multi-signal checklist. Cross-link those guides for individual signal detail and broad first-pass collection.

primarySourcesOpened.title: MDN: Fingerprinting
primarySourcesOpened.researchUse: Defines browser fingerprinting as combining browser and operating-system characteristics and lists version, timezone/language, fonts, settings, and display among example features.

primarySourcesOpened.title: MDN: HTMLCanvasElement.toDataURL()
primarySourcesOpened.researchUse: Documents that toDataURL returns an encoded representation of the canvas image; supports describing output/hash as a measured result, not a diagnosis by itself.

primarySourcesOpened.title: MDN: WebGLRenderingContext.getParameter()
primarySourcesOpened.researchUse: Documents parameter queries in a WebGL context; article avoids claiming a universal renderer string or guaranteed exposure.

primarySourcesOpened.title: MDN: NavigatorUAData.getHighEntropyValues()
primarySourcesOpened.researchUse: Documents the separate high-entropy Client Hints API used to distinguish UA surfaces and request conditions.

primarySourcesOpened.title: Chromium: User-Agent Reduction
primarySourcesOpened.researchUse: Records the staged Chromium UA-reduction rollout and migration toward UA-CH, supporting the caveat that reduced UA detail may be deliberate browser behavior.

primarySourcesOpened.title: Chrome for Developers: Chrome 152 release notes
primarySourcesOpened.researchUse: Provides a dated, platform-scoped release-note example (stable release dated 2026-08-25). The guide frames release notes as hypotheses to inspect, not proof of a specific device-level fingerprint change.

primarySourcesOpened.title: W3C: Mitigating Browser Fingerprinting in Web Specifications
primarySourcesOpened.researchUse: Standards guidance for considering and mitigating fingerprinting exposure; supports treating limited exposure as potentially intentional.
